commentary_segments.text: First of all, we want to review some definitions. In particular we want to review the differences between the four types of feedback amplifiers. We will then focus on transimpedance amplifiers. They are used mainly for current sensors such as photodiodes, voltammetric sensors, etc. Current amplifiers are next. At the end, some different transimpedance amplifiers are added, as they are widely used for photodiode receivers. Attention is paid to low-noise and high-frequency performance.
